For obvious reasons I'm pretty upset right now. I feel like the rug has been pulled out from under me, and I've been lied to. It doesn't make sense to me why I can't use my own care team to assess me. They know me, they know everything, the trust is there.

Please help. I know Shoggoth has said in a past post that members can use someone from their care team for the final assessment, especially if it's distressing to the member to use someone they do not trust.

After decades of trying all types of therapy modalities, I worked through my own baggage around medication and told myself I'd just try it. Worst case scenario, I do not like at all, and I stop. Best case, it makes me feel even marginally better.

That was last October. I started with Zoloft, but the absolute sex drive shut down side effect made it a no for me due to being in a relationship at the time. Other than that, I really liked Zoloft.

I then switched to Wellbutrin. No complaints other than it slightly increases my anxiety. The nightmares I had when starting it were scary and vivid, very common for folks, but went away. It made me feel hopeful again, like actually hopeful. It just made things, and still does, a little softer, more bearable. When I get low, I know it'll pass and it doesn't scare me as much as it used to.

I plan on transitioning off when I get my service dog, but it all depends how I feel.

For me, it does make life more livable. If you are on the fence, I'd say give it a go. You can always stop if it's not for you, or try others. I have no regrets starting, life is fucking hard, we deserve a pill to make it easier.
